name: Lakshay
body: Describe jaysha in your own words

name: Daisy
body:
I never met someone like you
You are special and cute, I like when sometimes you act dumb but it looks cute.
You are always ready with your open arms to help others
Ek cooker mei ek aloo 😂

name: Alfaz
body: Jaysha is genuinely one of the most caring people I know, and becoming friends with her was honestly one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. Isne mujhe bohot kuch sikhaya hai, especially kaise behave karna chahiye 🤣😭 and she’s always there for us whenever we need her. Baaki maine duniya mein 500 khoobsurat ladkiyan dekhi thi, phir Jaysha se mila aur woh number 500 hi hai abhi tak🤣

name: Shreya
body:
Woh insaan jisne muje aur Alfaz dono ko gaali dena sikhaya hai and bigaada hai (haath lagaaaa). Nobody would trust us on this but it’s true!
Literally the person who on her first day in new school decided to trust this random, gunda gardi karne wali ladki, hats off to you!! But it was the best decision of your life right? Yeah i know
She is easily influenced, goofy asf, always wants her way, but she is also the wisest of them all, and always has my back - never had to ask her for any of it
Loads of hugs to youuu (wohi waali ;))

name: Akanksha
body:
Hellooo jayjaa didi!!
My impression about youuu ummm
You are my elder sister u know my secrets and vice versa🫣 aap ka humor acha hai theek thak (mera he best h ik) kuch pyare shabd aapke mu se bht ache lagte hai sunn ke( bkl bc chutiyaa l*nd mera) oopsss😂😂 kraaaazzzyyyy bhaiiii hai na...you are very strong and extremely hardworking and aapko sacrifice karna aata hai mere se to zyada dekha he nai jaata hai...few days back i was going through the letters you gifted me on my birthday and sab mai front pe bff best friend likha tha uss time maybe hm notice nai kiye but ab dekhe to mereko bht bht acha laga❤️ pyaare hai aap bht thora dimaag kam hai samjhana padta hai😌 sometimes you should love yourself and stop being too harsh on yourself....stop listening to uncle sometimesss and thora sa ekdm little bit enjoy kariye 🙏🙏🙏kabhi kabhi he ignore krne bol rhe h har samay nai.. bht stress mai rehte h aap not at all good jayshaa didi sachii... jitna cool dp hai utne cool raha kariye😙 aapse ek baar he aajtak darr laga tha..itna ki hm baat bhi ni kar paate uss baare mai baaki to aapke saamne sb chill hai ab aur humlog bht ghumte hai thora kam ghumna chahiye hai na💀 itna sara baat itna sara gossip kya nai kiye hai but bht kuch baaki bhi hai...aadha baat to yaad bhi nahi hai sorryy😂🥹 sorry for my mistakes i know kabhi kabhi apko mera actions words tone kharab laga hai...all of it was unintentional i know abhi distance hai milna to bht he kam hogya hai... i think almost 1 month ho jayega mille hue...even if we have nothing to talk about my sticker game will not stop "it is what it is"🙂‍↔️ aapka coughing 😷🤧 achaaaaaa😙 i wish you a veryyy happyy birthdayyy jaysaaaaa didi❤️ love you babe (eeewwww)😂😂

name: Abhay
body: Hello Jaysha, yeh aapke badiya se boyfriend ne bola hai aapke liyeh kuch likhne ko. Wesse toh sach batao mann nhi hai because aapne aur Shreya ne jo baatei aur cheeze kari thi woh bachelor's party pe 🥲 But on the other hand mere help bhi kari Nishka ki shadi pe Shreya ki family k saath chill karne mei ;) toh thode bahut theek thak ho aap :P But chalo mazak masti chor kar you're one of the nicest person I've ever met and I'm blessed that Shreya has you as her best friend. But ek baat suno aap, Shreya ko yeh cute gifts dena band karo bhai, phir aap jeet jaate ho har saal cute waale section mei and no hugs for the both of you 🔪 ! Arey haan aapka toh birthday bhi hai naa :P Happy birthday :P

name: Apoorv
body: Jaysha, you are special because ordinary people don't go to the gym at 2 or 3 o'clock in the afternoon, but you do. Today is your special day, and I hope at least today Uncle & Aunty don't ditch you to be with Leo while they go on a date. If you feel “elevated” today, you are allowed to do so, with the blessing of the Apoorv Singh, of course. Can’t wait to see your father.

name: Siddharth
body:
You’re one of the kindest people I know. Which is annoying, because you also turn everything into a competition. Studies? Competition. Gym? Competition. Who has more number of study hours ? Competition. I’m pretty sure you’d compete over who blinks less if I let you.
Also, never thought you have been such an important cool elder senior ( obv you look old ) in library to guide me Also get me some # .
